decision: checked node, java, xcode and the android sdk before starting
why: wanted to know whether a real local build was even possible
evidence: env: node 24, jdk 17, xcode 26.6, android 36 + ndk 27
result: android and ios builds are both possible locally

decision: generated a fresh RN 0.86 turbo-module project and transplanted it instead of hand-editing the RN 0.72 template
why: hand-upgrading gradle 8.0.1 to 9.3.1, kotlin 1.7 to 2.1 and removing flipper invites mistakes; the generator is the lever

decision: wrote the copy and rename as a rerunnable script
why: mechanical rename across 22 files, and a script can be re-read and re-run
result: zero old tokens left after the rename

decision: transplanted the scaffold, renamed to the package, rebuilt the example
why: base the port on the current template rather than a patched old one

decision: removed the lefthook and commitlint git hooks
why: the template uses CI now, and the old hooks failed without an upstream and blocked commits
RN 0.86 codegen supports typed EventEmitter, which removes the string-based listeners

decision: changed the state enums to const objects
why: codegen cannot use TS enums, and const objects keep the same values so the native payload needs no cast

decision: fold detection module extends the generated spec and emits through the emit* methods
why: that is how a turbo module delivers events

decision: emitted the layout payload unwrapped instead of under a displayFeatures key
why: the typed event payload is the layout info itself, so the wrapper was redundant
result: runtime payload carried the keys directly

decision: iOS implements the spec as a no-op
why: keeps the documented iOS behaviour while still satisfying codegen and autolinking
result: pod install linked the pod and the iOS build succeeded

decision: ran the app on the Pixel_Fold API 36 emulator, folded it, then unfolded it
why: prove the events flow end to end rather than only compiling
evidence: logcat ReactNativeJS with temporary logging that was reverted
result: hinge angle 180 to 0 to 180, and a layout event with state FLAT and bounds

decision: bumped to 1.0.0 and wrote the changelog
why: dropping the legacy architecture and raising the RN floor is a breaking change

decision: kept Podfile.lock and the xcworkspace out of git
why: they are generated by pod install and rebuilt in CI, so committing them only drifts

decision: downloaded the iOS 26.5 simulator runtime to unblock the iOS build
why: Xcode 26.6 shipped the SDK but listed no eligible simulator until the runtime was installed

decision: independent reviewer flagged that getEnforcing would throw at import for iOS consumers who still disable autolinking
why: reviewer caught a real crash regression the green tests did not cover

decision: switched the spec to TurboModuleRegistry.get with a lazy accessor that throws a linking error only on Android
why: keep the old safe iOS behaviour of returning null instead of throwing at import
result: codegen still generates the spec; typecheck, lint, test green

decision: committed the transplant script, an iOS build excerpt, and a rerunnable Android smoke script
why: make the evidence resolve without the temp work dir, and give a reviewer a rerunnable check

decision: corrected the changelog to name the library Kotlin version and note the removed hooks and the iOS opt-out removal
why: reviewer flagged claims that did not match the build files
